title: Drain Worker Node for Maintenance
prompt:
Worker node `node02` requires OS package maintenance without interrupting running `drain-web` replicas in namespace `cka-drain`.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Safely cordon and drain `node02` (ignore DaemonSets, delete emptyDir data, and use `--force` if unmanaged Pods exist) so no Pods of Deployment `drain-web` remain scheduled on `node02`.
2. Record maintenance completion by creating `/opt/maintenance/node02.done` containing `DRAINED` on `node02`.
3. Keep `node02` cordoned (`SchedulingDisabled`) until maintenance verification completes.
hints: Run `kubectl drain node02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` from your workstation.
SSH to `node02` and run `sudo mkdir -p /opt/maintenance && echo DRAINED | sudo tee /opt/maintenance/node02.done`.
fast_solution_commands: ssh node02 'sudo mkdir -p /opt/maintenance && echo DRAINED | sudo tee /opt/maintenance/node02.done'

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: drain-web
  namespace: cka-drain
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: drain-web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: drain-web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: drain-web
  namespace: cka-drain
spec:
  selector:
    app: drain-web
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 80
